title: Import a STEP model into the current footprint
summary: Creates a 3D component body from a STEP file with ModelFactory_FromFilename, rotates and offsets it, and adds it once to the current footprint of the focused PCB library.
phrasings: add a STEP model to a footprint
attach a 3D body from a step file to a PcbLib footprint
place a 3D model with rotation and offset
list the 3D bodies of a footprint

commands.name: ImportStepModel
commands.description: Attach a STEP model to the current footprint as a 3D body
commands.params: File=<.step/.stp path> (required)|RotX=0|RotY=0|RotZ=0 (degrees)|X=0|Y=0 (mil, offset from the footprint reference point)|Z=0 (mil, model offset along Z)|Watch=true (second argument of ModelFactory_FromFilename)|Embed=true|false (optional; default: keep the factory's value)

commands.name: ListBodies
commands.description: List the 3D bodies of the current footprint
